item.title: Friday the 13th Part III in 3D - Screamfest Fears & Beers
item.description: Want to have a blast this January, Friday the 13th? Then join us at our Screamfest Fears & Beers screening of F﻿riday the 13th Part III in 3D at the TCL Chinese 6 Theatres. This film is a total blast to watch with a crowd!!

item.title: Ginger Snaps 25th Anniversary Screening
item.description: Join Screamfest at the LOOK Dine-In Cinemas Glendale for a thrilling night as we present the 25th anniversary screening of Canadian gem cult classic, Ginger Snaps!

item.title: FIRST WAVE 2025 LINEUP
item.description: Screamfest® Horror Film Festival, the largest and longest-running horror festival in the United States, today unveiled the first wave of competitive features and shorts for its 25th edition. Running October 7–16, 2025 at the TCL Chinese Theatre, the festival invites horror fans to experience twisted tales and terrifying films on the big screen. Tickets will be available soon at screamfestla.com.

item.title: 2025 Opening Night Film & Party Combo
item.description: Prepare for a night of horror and celebration! The 25th Annual Screamfest kicks off with the highly anticipated film, AFFECTION, screening on Opening Night at 7:30pm.

item.title: 2025 Screamfest Screenplay Finalists Announced!
item.description: A huge congratulations to all the Screamfest 2025 screenplay competition finalists! The suspense is building—we'll be revealing the Top Five Finalists very soon and the winning screenplay will be announced on October 16th!

item.title: Screamfest 2025 Award Winners
item.description: The 25th Annual Screamfet Horror Film Festival announces award winners. Awards were presented tonight, with the Mexican feature film Don’t Leave the Kids Alone directed by Emilio Portes emerging as a major winner.

item.title: My Bloody Valentine (1981) Screening at the LOOK Dine-In Cinemas
item.description: Catch the 1981 slasher My Bloody Valentine at LOOK Dine-In Glendale! Join Screamfest on Feb 12th for the45th Uncut 4K Restoration anniversary special screening, Q&A with Actress Helene Udy - Autography signing & live horror trivia.

item.title: The Slumber Party Massacre Q&A with Amy Holden Jones | Glendale
item.description: Join us at LOOK Dine-In Glendale on March 12 for The Slumber Party Massacre (1982) screening, an in-person Q&A with Amy Holden Jones, bonus short film Scissor Sleepover and trivia with prizes!

item.title: [RSVP] A24’s 'Undertone': An Exclusive Advance Screening for the Screamfest Community
item.description: Join Screamfest for a FREE advance screening of A24’s 'Undertone' at AMC Burbank Dolby Cinema. Experience the Sundance horror hit starring Nina Kiri. RSVP now!

item.title: The Blob (1988) Screening + Q&A with FX Legend Tony Gardner
item.description: There’s nothing quite like 80s practical gore on the big screen. On Thursday, April 16th at 7:30 PM, Screamfest is heading to the LOOK Dine-In Cinema in Glendale to celebrate one of the most effective horror remakes of all time: the 1988 version of The Blob. FX artist Tony Gardner joins Screamfest for an in-person Q&A.
